notes: No release before 0.5.0 may claim any of this is balanced: every magnitude in autonomy-weight.json carries tuningStatus untuned and the balance harness owns all of them, so this file is a measurement and not a balance claim. The universe also remains degenerate in known ways and this change closes none of them -- it demonstrates the binding one. These gate sweeps are 100 percent passive-control and submit no god verb. On the 2400-tick eight-strategy sweep, five of seven unrestricted strategies still finish holding ALL 51 reachable v1 nodes (mean 51.0, union 51, intersection 51), so cross-strategy containment stays 1.000 and prefix fidelity falls only 0.943 to 0.909. A set that contains everything is contained in every other set; composition is not yet a decision. What did move is every measure that is not saturated: the effort-weighted shape participation ratio 2.39 to 4.89, early-horizon minimum containment 0.742 to 0.612 at tick 240, and denial-warden against narrow-depth containment 0.771 to 0.643. capitalSnowball is NOT RECOMPUTED HERE and no number in this file is a claim about it: 0.502 is W7's figure for W7's build, and this change raised early referenceLibraryDepth from 7.145 to 10.435, which is exactly the input that metric is a Gini over -- so it must be re-measured before anyone quotes it against the 0.35 guard worshipSnowball is held to. That threshold belongs to god-agency and is not touched. W7's Enduring Canon effect is intact and not restored by this change: narrow-depth ends 0 of 12 in canon on both the w7-only and the w7-plus-w17 arms, against 7 of 12 before W7.
rationale: W17 made target selection a utility score (contracts.md 2.11, docs/design/value-sensitive-acquirer.md). Mages now choose WHICH node to work on by a six-term score shaped by species affinities, curiosity, age, personality and standing role, where they previously walked one cost-ordered queue that -- because v1 researchCost is a pure function of tier -- was identical for every mage in every universe. Adding autonomy-weight.json also moves contentHash 2512ea02 to d37624e3, so the old baseline is invalid by provenance regardless of any metric. What moved in this 200-run 600-tick gate: referenceNodesKnown 22.115 to 29.440 and referenceNodesGained the same +7.325 (+48.6 SE), referenceLibraryDepth 7.145 to 10.435 (+11.8 SE), referenceKnowledgeInstances 379.87 to 406.01 (+8.8 SE), referenceGrimoires 96.01 to 85.76 (-6.7 SE). Every population metric is inside tolerance and referencePeakPopulation is identical, which is the check that this is a knowledge-side change and not an economy-side one. The new numbers are right because the direction is the mechanism's: a mage who picks the node her species, age and role actually value reaches a useful frontier sooner, so early nodesKnown and library depth rise together, and she spends the months she would have spent copying the cheapest book on getting there -- hence fewer grimoires at 600 ticks against more instances overall.
